# Viral Flux Media - Digital Marketing Agency

Viral Flux Media - Digital Marketing Agency is a results-driven social media marketing, cinematic video production, and performance growth agency headquartered in Dombivli (Thane district), Maharashtra, India. We serve local businesses across Dombivli, Kalyan, Thane, and Mumbai, as well as high-growth brands worldwide.

## Service Scopes & Execution Capabilities
- **Organic Social Media Management**: Consistent feed content, high-retention reels, community management, brand voice development, and monthly analytics reporting.
- **Viral Reel Engine**: On-location 4K cinema shoots, hook scripting, high-retention video editing, Hollywood sound design, color grading, and Meta distribution.
- **Performance Marketing & Paid Ads**: Hyper-local radius targeting across Dombivli, Kalyan, Thane, and Mumbai on Meta & Google Ads with click-to-WhatsApp conversion funnels.
- **Client Retainers**: Tailored on a monthly basis according to client growth goals, filming frequency, and multi-channel deliverables.
